recipe.title: Clementine, Pistachio & Pumpkin Seed Snack Boxes
recipe.description: A crisp, naturally sweet portable snack pairing whole clementines with unsalted pistachios and pumpkin seeds for contrasting freshness, crunch and satisfying healthy fats.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 2 medium clementines; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.preparation: Keep whole and unpeeled for transport.
ingredients.notes: Choose firm fruit with intact peel and no soft or damaged areas.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 40 g from the pack; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Unsalted roasted pistachios are ideal for maximum crunch, but plain unsalted shelled pistachios are also suitable.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 20 g from the pack; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Use fresh seeds with a clean, nutty aroma and no stale or bitter flavour.

equipment.notes: Used to portion the nuts and seeds.
Choose containers large enough to hold the clementine without crushing it.

mise_en_place.instruction: Inspect the clementines and select 2 firm, undamaged fruit. Leave them whole and unpeeled.
mise_en_place.endpoint: Two sound clementines with intact peel are ready for packing.

mise_en_place.instruction: Weigh 40 g unsalted shelled pistachios and 20 g pumpkin seeds.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The nuts and seeds are accurately portioned and ready to divide between the two snack boxes.

procedure.title: Divide the nuts and seeds
procedure.instruction: Divide the 40 g pistachios and 20 g pumpkin seeds evenly between the two snack containers, giving each serving approximately 20 g pistachios and 10 g pumpkin seeds.
procedure.endpoint: Each container holds approximately half of both the pistachios and pumpkin seeds.

procedure.title: Pack the clementines
procedure.instruction: Place 1 whole, unpeeled clementine into each container with the pistachio and pumpkin-seed mixture, then close the lids securely. Keep the clementines whole until eating so citrus juice cannot soften the nuts and seeds.
procedure.endpoint: Each sealed snack box contains 1 clementine, approximately 20 g pistachios and approximately 10 g pumpkin seeds.

corrective_actions.condition: A clementine is too large to fit without being crushed.
corrective_actions.action: Carry that clementine separately rather than peeling or cutting it before transport.

plating.instruction: At the time of eating, peel the clementine and eat the segments alongside the pistachios and pumpkin seeds.

storage.storage_instructions: For same-day use, keep the sealed boxes in a cool, dry place away from direct heat. If assembled in advance, refrigerate for up to 2 days. Keep the clementines whole and unpeeled until eating so the nuts and seeds remain dry and crisp.

either_retailer: Unsalted shelled pistachios — 1 pack; use 40 g.

restaurant_quality_features: Sweet-acid fresh citrus against rich, nutty pistachios
Contrasting crisp pistachio and pumpkin-seed textures
Ingredients kept separate from citrus juice until eating for maximum crunch
nutrition_notes: Morning snacks have no minimum protein requirement.
Pistachios and pumpkin seeds contribute predominantly unsaturated fats, fibre, protein and minerals.
Clementine contributes fruit, vitamin C and additional fibre.
critical_success_factors: Keep the clementines whole until the snack is eaten.
Use fresh, unsalted nuts and seeds without stale or rancid flavours.
Portion the nuts and seeds evenly so both servings remain close to the intended energy target.
